subject.title: feat(skills): publish large bundles via staged upload

question: Should ClawHub adopt this public skill staged-upload and user-scoped ticket contract once archive extraction is safely bounded?
rationale: The PR adds a durable public API and storage trust boundary; code review can identify the unsafe extraction, but maintainers must own whether this protocol is the permanent skill-publishing contract.

options.title: Adopt after hardening
options.body: Keep the proposed package-style protocol, require bounded extraction and focused trust-boundary documentation, then validate it with a real large-bundle publish.

options.title: Redesign the transport
options.body: Pause this PR and choose a different large-skill transport or archive format before committing to the public route and ticket fields.

recommendation.title: Adopt after hardening
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed package-style protocol, require bounded extraction and focused trust-boundary documentation, then validate it with a real large-bundle publish.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the public API, Convex persistence, CLI behavior, and release contract rather than one isolated implementation file.
